# proxmox_user_tokens (Data Source)

Lists the API tokens of one user from `/access/users/{userid}/token`, sorted by token id. Token secrets are never exposed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_user_tokens" "root" {
  user_id = "root@pam"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `user_id` (String) User in `name@realm` form.

### Read-Only

- `tokens` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tokens))

<a id="nestedatt--tokens"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tokens`

Read-Only:

- `comment` (String)
- `expire` (Number)
- `privsep` (Boolean)
- `token_id` (String)
